We operate a fleet of over a ''hundred thousand'' mega-barges, and we rarely get searched.|[[Perla]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 5">[[Star Wars (2013) 5|''Star Wars'' (2013) 5]]</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Center_Sanitation_Department_card.png|thumb|right|220px|An Imperial Center Sanitation Department ID]]
The '''Imperial Center Sanitation Department''', also called '''Coruscant Sanitation''', was a department on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was responsible for processing the massive amounts of waste. Waste was removed from the planet via [[Garbage barge/Legends|mega-barges]]. Because the barges were rarely searched, the Sanitation Department was rife with corruption amongst its members, who took opportunities to make money on [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations.
